beats.text: What actually happens when you type a web address and press Enter? It feels instant, but a lot happens in less than a second.

v3.text: [excited] What actually happens when you type a web address and press Enter? [curious] It feels instant… but a LOT happens in less than a second!

v2.text: What actually happens when you type a web address and press Enter? It feels instant, but a lot happens in less than a second.

beats.text: First, your browser asks a DNS server to turn the name into an IP address. Think of it as the internet's phone book.

v3.text: [enthusiastic] First, your browser asks a DNS server to turn the name into an IP address. Think of it as the internet's phone book!

v2.text: First, your browser asks a DNS server to turn the name into an IP address. Think of it as the internet's phone book.

beats.text: Next, it opens a connection to that server. With HTTPS, both sides agree on a secret key, so nobody in the middle can read your data.

v3.text: [confident] Next, it opens a connection to that server. [excited] With HTTPS, both sides agree on a secret key… so nobody in the middle can read your data!

v2.text: Next, it opens a connection to that server. With HTTPS, both sides agree on a secret key, so nobody in the middle can read your data.

beats.text: Then the browser sends a request, and the server sends back HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The browser reads them, builds the page, and paints it on your screen.

v3.text: [enthusiastic] Then the browser sends a request, and the server sends back HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The browser reads them, builds the page, and paints it on your screen!

v2.text: Then the browser sends a request, and the server sends back HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The browser reads them, builds the page, and paints it on your screen.

beats.text: Honestly, it's one of the most impressive things we use every day, and we barely notice it. Next time a page loads, remember the tiny journey it just made.
